description: This file implements an Azure-specific real-time language model service by extending a base OpenAI real-time service. It sets up WebSocket connections with Azure endpoints, manages authentication headers, and handles connection logic, including error handling.

classes.name: AzureRealtimeLLMService
classes.description: Azure OpenAI Realtime LLM service with Azure-specific authentication, extending the OpenAIRealtimeLLMService to handle Azure WebSocket connections and headers.

methods.name: __init__( self, *, api_key: str, base_url: str, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Initializes the AzureRealtimeLLMService with API key and base URL, passing additional arguments to the parent class.

methods.name: _connect(self)
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection to the Azure endpoint, including error handling and managing the connection state.
